description: Immutable data object representing a standing instruction for account transfers in Fineract, including details about source/destination accounts, transfer types, recurrence, and associated options.

classes.name: StandingInstructionData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a standing instruction for account transfers, including options and recurrence details.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template instance with null/default values and provided options collections.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new StandingInstructionData instance with specified values.

methods.name: withTemplateData
methods.description: Creates a new instance by combining existing instruction data with a template.

methods.name: withTransferData
methods.description: Creates a new instance with updated transfer transaction data.

methods.name: getInstructionType
methods.description: Returns the instruction type enum based on stored data.

methods.name: getRecurrenceType
methods.description: Returns the recurrence type enum based on stored data.

methods.name: getRecurrenceFrequency
methods.description: Returns the recurrence frequency enum based on stored data.

methods.name: getFromAccountType
methods.description: Returns the source account type enum.

methods.name: getToAccountType
methods.description: Returns the destination account type enum.

methods.name: getRecurrenceOnDay
methods.description: Returns the day of month for recurrence, if applicable.

methods.name: getRecurrenceOnMonth
methods.description: Returns the month of recurrence, if applicable.

methods.name: toTransferType
methods.description: Maps transfer type to specific loan transaction type value if applicable.
